canonical_project: Canar Telecom Sudan Khartoum / Canartel DC
notes: Inflect lists an operational Canar Telecom Sudan data center on Al-Mashtal Street, Khartoum with colocation, connectivity, 11,840 sq ft raised floor and 250 kVA power. Data Center Platform lists Canartel DC at Canar Tower, Al-Mashtal Street. Canar's own site confirms data center management capability but not this facility's specs.
